This spends your pick: you can't choose another bounty until the board refreshes.
ui.allTiersClaimedSub: You've collected every weekend reward. Nice work!
ui.bountyBoardSub: Pick ONE sealed bounty. Boards are rare (every few days), and choosing or abandoning closes this one.
ui.collection.allComplete: EVERY SET COMPLETE. THE MUSEUM IS FULL.
ui.collection.bonusOn: on everything you earn, permanently. Never resets with the weekend.

ui.collection.firNote: Only items marked FOUND IN RAID can be donated. Donations are permanent.

ui.market.sub: Six cards, rolled for you. Flip to see what is on offer.

ui.modifier.rate: {0} GP PER KILL  ·  MAX {1} KILLS A RAID
ui.modtut.0.body: Some weekends roll a modifier: a rule that changes how the whole weekend pays out. It shows here whenever one is running, and it's the same for everyone on the server until the weekend ends.
ui.modtut.0.title: This weekend has a modifier
ui.modtut.1.body: A featured weapon class pays bonus GP per kill with that kind of gun, up to a cap each raid. Double Pay doubles every GP reward you claim. Double XP doubles the XP your raids pay.
ui.modtut.1.title: Three kinds
ui.modtut.2.body: Modifiers are meant to change what you bring or when you play. Not every weekend gets one, so when it does, it's worth a look before you kit up. Check back here each weekend to see what's live.
ui.modtut.2.title: Worth planning around
ui.noBountiesSub: Contracts aren't a daily thing - a new board only turns up every few days. Going a couple of days without one is normal. The timer above shows when the next is due.
ui.noDailiesSub: New dailies appear here after the next reset.
ui.notif.claimBoth: {0} daily and {1} weekly waiting to claim

ui.notif.longestShotBeat: Beat your old best of {0} m
ui.notif.nothingToDepositBody: No GP coins found. If you have some, open your inventory once, then try again.
ui.notif.recordFirst: {0} - your first one on the board
ui.notif.rewardsWaitingSub: Open the DROPS tab to collect
ui.notif.supplyLandedBody: The crate is on the crew's position.
ui.notif.tradeFailedBody: Couldn't remove the items. Open your inventory once, then try again.
ui.record.mostPmcKillsRaid: Most PMC kills in a raid
ui.reroll.confirmBody: Swap "{0}" for a different challenge of the same difficulty for {1} GP?
ui.reroll.confirmWarn: Progress on this challenge is lost. The replacement is worth the same points, so your tier rewards stay reachable.
ui.shopEmptySub: No items in stock right now. Check back after the next restock.
ui.squad.empty: No squadmates on the server yet.
ui.stats.howItPays: Beating a record pays GP for how far you beat it by, so chipping away earns the same as one big run.
ui.stats.noneSub: Waiting on the server. Your personal bests show up here once it answers.
ui.tip.1: Extract alive to bank your challenge progress. Dying in raid keeps none of it.
ui.tip.2: Dailies reset every day. Knock out the easy ones early for quick GP.
ui.tip.3: Tap your Widget Key in raid to check the tracker.
ui.tip.4: Survival challenges reward patience. Sometimes the smart play is sitting tight.
ui.tip.5: Grenade kills have their own challenges now. Cook a frag and collect.
ui.tip.6: Reward tiers pay GP on top of the loot crate. Claim all three before the weekend ends.
ui.tip.7: Hold some looted GP coins back if there's still gear you want from REF.
ui.tip.8: Weekend challenges only count during the weekend window. Dailies pay out all week.
ui.title: WEEKEND DROPS

ui.trophy.quip.1: It is yours. Try not to lose it in Factory.
ui.trophy.quip.2: Somebody died for this once. Not you, this time.
ui.trophy.quip.3: Straight to the stash. Do not look back.
ui.trophy.quip.5: The stash gets a little heavier.
ui.trophy.quip.6: Earned, not found. There is a difference.
ui.trophy.quip.7: Keep it insured. Keep it close.

ui.tut.0.body: Fresh challenges drop every weekend, you earn GP and loot crates, then spend GP in the shop or take on a bounty. Here's the quick tour.
ui.tut.0.title: Welcome to Weekend Drops
ui.tut.1.body: Four tabs run the whole thing: Weekly and Daily challenges, the GP Shop, and the Contracts bounty board. Click one to switch, we'll walk through each.
ui.tut.1.title: Four tabs
ui.tut.10.body: Bounties are rare: a new board only turns up every few days, so going a couple days with none is normal, not a bug. Cards are sealed, you see the GP reward and type but not the target or map. Accept ONE to reveal it; a crew spawns on your next raid of that map for a big payout. Accepting or abandoning closes the board until the next one, so choose carefully.
ui.tut.10.title: Bounty Board
ui.tut.11.body: The fifth tab is a museum. Donate rare found-in-raid collectibles (figurines, posters, antiques) to fill sets. Each piece pays GP on the spot, and completing a set grants a permanent GP bonus that never resets with the weekend. Donations are permanent: the piece is gone for good, so the confirm screen warns you before every one.
ui.tut.11.title: The Collection
ui.tut.12.body: The museum lives as long as your character does. A profile wipe clears it along with everything else. Prestige clears it too, but it pays out first: GP for every piece donated plus a bonus for each completed set, credited to your fresh character so the years of collecting carry over as a head start.
ui.tut.12.title: Wipes and prestige
ui.tut.2.body: Your GP balance is a virtual wallet. You earn GP from daily challenges and weekend tiers, top it up with coins you find in raid, and spend it all in the Shop.
ui.tut.2.title: GP, your balance
ui.tut.3.body: Grabbed GP coins in a raid? Hit DEPOSIT, pick an amount, and confirm to bank them. Leave a few in your stash if you've still got shopping to do at REF.
ui.tut.3.title: Deposit looted coins
ui.tut.4.body: Inside the DEPOSIT screen there's a SEND TO A FRIEND button. Gift some of your GP balance to another profile, your own alt or a Fika teammate. They get it as a gold drop next time they're in the menu. Great for bankrolling a new character.
ui.tut.4.title: Send GP to a friend
ui.tut.5.body: Every weekend challenge is worth difficulty points: 1 easy, 2 medium, 3 hard. You don't have to finish them all, just earn enough points to reach each tier. Stuck with one you can't do? Reroll it for GP; the swap is always worth the same points.
ui.tut.5.title: Weekly challenges
ui.tut.6.body: Your points fill this track. When a tier lights up, hit CLAIM. Each one mails you a loot crate plus a GP bonus (150, 300, or 500). Claim them before the weekend's over.
ui.tut.6.title: Reward tiers
ui.tut.7.body: Playing with Fika? A rivalry board shows at the bottom of the Weekly tab, everyone in your group ranked by GP earned this weekend. Pure bragging rights. Solo players won't see it.
ui.tut.7.title: Squad rivalry board
ui.tut.8.body: A fresh set every day, each paying GP straight to your balance. Clear the whole set for a bonus payout.
ui.tut.8.title: Daily challenges
ui.tut.9.body: Spend your GP here on storage cases, Arena crates, ammo care-package kits, and rare trophy buys. The stock refreshes on a timer, so check back for new items.
ui.tut.9.title: GP Shop
